612	def _build_message(msg, an, ns, ar, rcode):
613	    """一次性编码完整报文，返回 (out, body_base, 各区段 RR 结束偏移, flags)。
614	
615	    尾删只保留报文前缀：压缩指针只指向更早写入的名字，保留的前缀
616	    自身即合法报文，故按结束偏移切片即可，无需反复重新编码。
617	    """
618	    flags = _FLAGS_RESPONSE | (msg["flags"] & _FLAGS_KEPT) | rcode
619	    out = bytearray()
620	    out += msg["id"].to_bytes(2, "big")
621	    out += flags.to_bytes(2, "big")
622	    out += len(msg["questions"]).to_bytes(2, "big")
623	    out += len(an).to_bytes(2, "big")
624	    out += len(ns).to_bytes(2, "big")
625	    out += len(ar).to_bytes(2, "big")
626	    offsets = {}
627	    for question in msg["questions"]:
628	        _write_name(out, _normalize_name(question["name"]), offsets)
629	        out += question["type"].to_bytes(2, "big")
630	        out += question["class"].to_bytes(2, "big")
631	    body_base = len(out)
632	    section_ends = []
633	    for section in (an, ns, ar):
634	        ends = []
635	        for labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata in section:
636	            _write_name(out, labels, offsets)
637	            out += rrtype.to_bytes(2, "big")
638	            out += rrclass.to_bytes(2, "big")
639	            out += ttl.to_bytes(4, "big")
640	            out += len(rdata).to_bytes(2, "big")
641	            out += rdata
642	            ends.append(len(out))
643	        section_ends.append(ends)
644	    return out, body_base, section_ends, flags

647	def _encode_response(query, model, rcode):
648	    """把查询报文与应答模型编码为确定性权威应答报文（rcode 由内部指定）。"""
649	    if not isinstance(query, bytes):
650	        raise TypeError("query must be bytes")
651	    _check_int(rcode, "rcode")
652	    if not 0 <= rcode <= 0xF:
653	        raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
654	    an, ns, ar, limit = _validate_model(model)
655	    msg = decode_query(query)
656	    if msg["flags"] & 0x8000:
657	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
658	    if not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
659	        raise EncodeError("limit out of range")
660	    truncated = False
661	    # 区段计数为 16 位：超过 65535 条时按 ar、ns、an 尾删整条并置 TC，
662	    # 不得让计数溢出。
663	    for section in (ar, ns, an):
664	        if len(section) > _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:
665	            del section[_MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:]
666	            truncated = True
667	    out, body_base, (an_ends, ns_ends, ar_ends), flags = _build_message(
668	        msg, an, ns, ar, rcode)
669	    na, nn, nr = len(an), len(ns), len(ar)
670	    total_end = ar_ends[-1] if ar_ends else (
671	        ns_ends[-1] if ns_ends else (an_ends[-1] if an_ends else body_base))
672	    if total_end > limit:
673	        # 超长：先尾删 ar，ar 清空仍超长再尾删 ns，最后尾删 an。
674	        truncated = True
675	        nr = bisect_right(ar_ends, limit)
676	        if nr == 0:
677	            nn = bisect_right(ns_ends, limit)
678	            if nn == 0:
679	                na = bisect_right(an_ends, limit)
680	                if na == 0 and body_base > limit:
681	                    raise EncodeError("header and question exceed limit")
682	    if nr:
683	        end = ar_ends[nr - 1]
684	    elif nn:
685	        end = ns_ends[nn - 1]
686	    elif na:
687	        end = an_ends[na - 1]
688	    else:
689	        end = body_base
690	    result = bytearray(out[:end])
691	    result[6:8] = na.to_bytes(2, "big")
692	    result[8:10] = nn.to_bytes(2, "big")
693	    result[10:12] = nr.to_bytes(2, "big")
694	    if truncated:
695	        result[2:4] = (flags | _FLAG_TC).to_bytes(2, "big")
696	    return bytes(result)
697

704	def edns(query: bytes, model: dict, rcode: int = 0) -> bytes:
705	    """把（可含 OPT 的）查询报文与应答模型编码为 EDNS 应答报文。
706	
707	    query/model 的解码与编码契约同 decode_query/encode_response；查询
708	    AR 限 0 或 1 条，有则须为未压缩根 owner、TYPE41、CLASS512..65535、
709	    扩展码/版本 0、flags 仅 DO、RDLENGTH0 的 OPT。非法 AR/OPT、截断、
710	    尾随或 model 含 OPT 抛 EDNSError。rcode 须非 bool 整数（类型错
711	    TypeError）：有 OPT 限 0..4095、无 OPT 限 0..15，越界 EncodeError。
712	    无 OPT 时上限 min(model.limit, 512) 且不回 OPT；有 OPT 时上限
713	    min(model.limit, CLASS)，应答 ar 末项为同 CLASS 根 OPT，
714	    TTL=(rcode>>4)<<24|DO，头部低 4 位为 rcode&15。编码其余同
715	    encode_response：超限按 ar、ns、an 尾删并置 TC，OPT 不删；
716	    问题与 OPT 超限抛 EncodeError。
717	    """
718	    if not isinstance(query, bytes):
719	        raise TypeError("query must be bytes")
720	    _check_int(rcode, "rcode")
721	    an, ns, ar, limit = _validate_model(model)
722	    msg, opt = _decode_edns_query(query)
723	    for section in (an, ns, ar):
724	        if any(rr[1] == _TYPE_OPT for rr in section):
725	            raise EDNSError("model must not contain OPT records")
726	    if msg["flags"] & 0x8000:
727	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
728	    if not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT:
729	        raise EncodeError("limit out of range")
730	    opt_wire = b""
731	    if opt is None:
732	        if not 0 <= rcode <= 0xF:
733	            raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
734	        limit = min(limit, _MAX_MESSAGE_LEN)
735	    else:
736	        if not 0 <= rcode <= _MAX_EDNS_RCODE:
737	            raise EncodeError("rcode out of range")
738	        opt_class, do = opt
739	        limit = min(limit, opt_class)
740	        ttl = ((rcode >> 4) << 24) | (_FLAG_DO if do else 0)
741	        opt_wire = (b"\x00" + _TYPE_OPT.to_bytes(2, "big")
742	                    + opt_class.to_bytes(2, "big") + ttl.to_bytes(4, "big")
743	                    + b"\x00\x00")
744	    truncated = False
745	    # 区段计数为 16 位：OPT 占 ar 一席且不删，model 的 ar 预算相应减一。
746	    max_ar = _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS - (1 if opt_wire else 0)
747	    if len(ar) > max_ar:
748	        del ar[max_ar:]
749	        truncated = True
750	    for section in (ns, an):
751	        if len(section) > _MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:
752	            del section[_MAX_SECTION_RECORDS:]
753	            truncated = True
754	    out, body_base, (an_ends, ns_ends, ar_ends), flags = _build_message(
755	        msg, an, ns, ar, rcode & 0xF)
756	    body_limit = limit - len(opt_wire)  # 为 OPT 预留，OPT 不参与尾删
757	    na, nn, nr = len(an), len(ns), len(ar)
758	    total_end = ar_ends[-1] if ar_ends else (
759	        ns_ends[-1] if ns_ends else (an_ends[-1] if an_ends else body_base))
760	    if total_end > body_limit:
761	        # 超长：先尾删 ar，ar 清空仍超长再尾删 ns，最后尾删 an。
762	        truncated = True
763	        nr = bisect_right(ar_ends, body_limit)
764	        if nr == 0:
765	            nn = bisect_right(ns_ends, body_limit)
766	            if nn == 0:
767	                na = bisect_right(an_ends, body_limit)
768	                if na == 0 and body_base > body_limit:
769	                    raise EncodeError("header and question exceed limit")
770	    if nr:
771	        end = ar_ends[nr - 1]
772	    elif nn:
773	        end = ns_ends[nn - 1]
774	    elif na:
775	        end = an_ends[na - 1]
776	    else:
777	        end = body_base
778	    result = bytearray(out[:end])
779	    result += opt_wire
780	    result[6:8] = na.to_bytes(2, "big")
781	    result[8:10] = nn.to_bytes(2, "big")
782	    result[10:12] = (nr + (1 if opt_wire else 0)).to_bytes(2, "big")
783	    if truncated:
784	        result[2:4] = (flags | _FLAG_TC).to_bytes(2, "big")
785	    return bytes(result)

800	def _hop(records, nodes, origin, current, qtype):
801	    """单跳查找 current 的 qtype 记录，返回 (kind, rrs)。
802	
803	    kind 为 "answer"（rrs 为命中记录，通配 owner 已合成为 current）、
804	    "cname"（rrs 为合成后的单条 CNAME，仅 qtype≠5 时出现）、
805	    "nodata"（节点或通配存在但无该类型）或 "nxdomain"。
806	    """
807	    if tuple(current) in nodes:
808	        # 同名节点存在（含空非终端）：不回退通配。
809	        if qtype != _TYPE_CNAME:
810	            for rr in records:
811	                if rr[0] == current and rr[1] == _TYPE_CNAME:
812	                    return "cname", rr
813	        matched = [rr for rr in records
814	                   if rr[0] == current and rr[1] == qtype]
815	        if matched:
816	            return "answer", matched[:1] if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME else matched
817	        return "nodata", None
818	    # 节点不存在：取最长既存后缀，只检查 "*."+该后缀。
819	    encloser = None
820	    for i in range(1, len(current) - len(origin) + 1):
821	        if tuple(current[i:]) in nodes:
822	            encloser = current[i:]
823	            break
824	    wildcard = ["*"] + encloser
825	    if qtype != _TYPE_CNAME:
826	        for rr in records:
827	            if rr[0] == wildcard and rr[1] == _TYPE_CNAME:
828	                return "cname", (list(current), rr[1], rr[2], rr[3], rr[4])
829	    matched = [rr for rr in records
830	               if rr[0] == wildcard and rr[1] == qtype]
831	    if matched:
832	        if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
833	            matched = matched[:1]
834	        return "answer", [(list(current), rr[1], rr[2], rr[3], rr[4])
835	                          for rr in matched]
836	    if any(rr[0] == wildcard for rr in records):
837	        return "nodata", None
838	    return "nxdomain", None
839

841	def _resolve_chain(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype):
842	    """在 origin 内解析（qtype≠5 时跟随 CNAME 链），返回 (rcode, an, ns)。"""
843	    soa = [rr for rr in records if rr[0] == origin and rr[1] == _TYPE_SOA]
844	    if qtype == _TYPE_CNAME:
845	        kind, rrs = _hop(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype)
846	        if kind == "answer":
847	            return 0, rrs, []
848	        if kind == "nodata":
849	            return 0, [], soa
850	        return _RCODE_NXDOMAIN, [], soa
851	    an = []
852	    seen = {tuple(qlabels)}
853	    current = list(qlabels)
854	    while True:
855	        kind, rrs = _hop(records, nodes, origin, current, qtype)
856	        if kind == "answer":
857	            return 0, an + rrs, []
858	        if kind == "nodata":
859	            return 0, an, soa
860	        if kind == "nxdomain":
861	            return _RCODE_NXDOMAIN, an, soa
862	        # 命中 CNAME：先入链，再查目标；第 17 条或名称重复即失败。
863	        if len(an) >= _MAX_CNAME_CHAIN:
864	            raise CNAMEError("cname chain too long")
865	        an.append(rrs)
866	        target = _decode_cname_target(rrs[4])
867	        if tuple(target) in seen:
868	            raise CNAMEError("cname chain loop")
869	        seen.add(tuple(target))
870	        if (len(target) < len(origin)
871	                or target[len(target) - len(origin):] != origin):
872	            return 0, an, []  # 目标在 origin 外：返回积累链，ns 为空
873	        current = target

876	def _answer_plan(msg, origin, records, zone_class):
877	    """answer 的完整（未截断）应答计划，返回 (rcode, an, ns)。
878	
879	    msg 为已解码且通过可应答性检查的单问题查询；zone 已校验，
880	    RR 均为规范化元组。
881	    """
882	    question = msg["questions"][0]
883	    qlabels = _normalize_name(question["name"])
884	    qtype = question["type"]
885	    an = []
886	    ns = []
887	    if question["class"] != zone_class:
888	        rcode = _RCODE_REFUSED  # 问题 class 与 zone 不同：三段为空
889	    elif (len(qlabels) < len(origin)
890	            or qlabels[len(qlabels) - len(origin):] != origin):
891	        rcode = _RCODE_NXDOMAIN  # 查询名在 origin 之外
892	        ns = [rr for rr in records
893	              if rr[0] == origin and rr[1] == _TYPE_SOA]
894	    else:
895	        # 节点集：origin、各记录 owner（含通配 owner）及其间的空非终端。
896	        nodes = {tuple(origin)}
897	        for labels, _rrtype, _cls, _ttl, _rdata in records:
898	            for i in range(len(labels) - len(origin)):
899	                nodes.add(tuple(labels[i:]))
900	        rcode, an, ns = _resolve_chain(records, nodes, origin, qlabels, qtype)
901	    return rcode, an, ns

1025	class PositiveCache:

1036	    min(SOA ttl, 第五个 uint32)，格式错或负 TTL 为 0 则不缓存。
1037	    负命中时 RCODE 不变，an/ar 为空，ns 仅该 SOA 且 ttl 随经过时间递减。
1038	
1039	    查找顺序为正缓存、NODATA、NXDOMAIN；正负条目共用容量与同一 FIFO。

1043	    def __init__(self, zone: dict):

1045	        # 校验异常与 answer 完全一致。
1046	        zone = copy.deepcopy(zone)
1047	        self._origin, self._records, self._zone_class = _validate_zone(zone)
1048	        self._entries = {}  # 正缓存键 -> (插入时刻, 规范化 an)
1049	        self._neg_entries = {}  # 负缓存键 -> (插入时刻, rcode, 规范化 SOA, 负 TTL)
1050	        self._order = deque()  # (类别, 键) 插入次序；与两个字典的键集合始终一致
1051	        self._last_now = None  # 上次成功 resolve 的时钟值
1052	
1053	    def _negative_entry(self, key, rcode, an, ns, now):
1054	        """完整计划可负缓存时返回 (负缓存键, 条目)，否则返回 None。"""
1055	        if an or rcode not in (0, _RCODE_NXDOMAIN):
1056	            return None
1057	        if (len(ns) != 1 or ns[0][0] != self._origin
1058	                or ns[0][1] != _TYPE_SOA):
1059	            return None
1060	        soa = ns[0]
1061	        minimum = _parse_soa_minimum(soa[4])
1062	        if minimum is None:
1063	            return None
1064	        neg_ttl = min(soa[3], minimum)
1065	        if neg_ttl == 0:
1066	            return None
1067	        if rcode == _RCODE_NXDOMAIN:
1068	            neg_key = ("nxdomain", key[0], key[2])  # 匹配任意 qtype
1069	        else:
1070	            neg_key = ("nodata",) + key
1071	        return neg_key, (now, rcode, soa, neg_ttl)

1073	    def resolve(self, query: bytes, now: int,

1075	        if not isinstance(now, int) or isinstance(now, bool):
1076	            raise TypeError("now must be int")
1077	        if now < 0 or (self._last_now is not None and now < self._last_now):
1078	            raise CacheError("now must be non-negative and monotonic")
1079	        # query、limit 的异常沿用 answer。
1080	        msg = decode_query(query)
1081	        _check_int(limit, "limit")
1082	        if (msg["flags"] & 0x8000 or len(msg["questions"]) != 1
1083	                or not _MIN_LIMIT <= limit <= _MAX_LIMIT):
1084	            raise EncodeError("query or limit not answerable")
1085	        question = msg["questions"][0]
1086	        key = (question["name"], question["type"], question["class"])
1087	        expired = None  # 到期条目在 _order 中的标记键，待编码成功后清理
1088	        entry = self._entries.get(key)
1089	        if entry is not None:
1090	            inserted, an = entry
1091	            elapsed = now - inserted
1092	            min_ttl = min(rr[3] for rr in an)
1093	            if elapsed < min_ttl:
1094	                aged = [(labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl - elapsed, rdata)
1095	                        for labels, rrtype, rrclass, ttl, rdata in an]
1096	                # 用本次 ID、flags、问题段、limit 重编码；截断不改条目，
1097	                # 命中也不改变插入次序。
1098	                response = _encode_plan(query, 0, aged, [], limit)
1099	                self._last_now = now
1100	                return response, True
1101	            # 到期：先记下，待新应答编码成功后再清理，保证失败不改状态。
1102	            expired = ("pos", key)
1103	        else:
1104	            # 正缓存未中：NODATA 先于 NXDOMAIN 查找。
1105	            neg_key = ("nodata",) + key
1106	            neg = self._neg_entries.get(neg_key)
1107	            if neg is None:
1108	                neg_key = ("nxdomain", key[0], key[2])
1109	                neg = self._neg_entries.get(neg_key)
1110	            if neg is not None:
1111	                inserted, rcode, soa, neg_ttl = neg
1112	                elapsed = now - inserted
1113	                if elapsed < neg_ttl:
1114	                    aged_soa = (soa[0], soa[1], soa[2],
1115	                                neg_ttl - elapsed, soa[4])
1116	                    # 用本次 ID、flags、问题段、limit 重编码；RCODE 不变，
1117	                    # an/ar 为空，ns 仅 SOA；截断不改条目与插入次序。
1118	                    response = _encode_plan(query, rcode, [], [aged_soa], limit)
1119	                    self._last_now = now
1120	                    return response, True
1121	                expired = ("neg", neg_key)
1122	        # 未命中（含到期）：先按 answer 语义生成未截断的完整有序应答。
1123	        rcode, an, ns = _answer_plan(
1124	            msg, self._origin, self._records, self._zone_class)
1125	        # 先编码成功再落条目，保证编码失败不改变任何状态。
1126	        response = _encode_plan(query, rcode, an, ns, limit)
1127	        if expired is not None:
1128	            tag, ekey = expired
1129	            del (self._entries if tag == "pos" else self._neg_entries)[ekey]
1130	            self._order.remove(expired)  # 到期删除后按未命中刷新
1131	        if rcode == 0 and not ns and an and all(rr[3] > 0 for rr in an):
1132	            self._entries[key] = (now, an)
1133	            self._order.append(("pos", key))
1134	        else:
1135	            negative = self._negative_entry(key, rcode, an, ns, now)
1136	            if negative is not None:
1137	                neg_key, neg_entry = negative
1138	                self._neg_entries[neg_key] = neg_entry
1139	                self._order.append(("neg", neg_key))
1140	        if len(self._order) > _CACHE_CAPACITY:
1141	            tag, oldest = self._order.popleft()  # 满时淘汰最早插入者
1142	            del (self._entries if tag == "pos" else self._neg_entries)[oldest]
1143	        self._last_now = now
1144	        return response, False

1187	def _reply_question_end(reply, qdcount):
1188	    """按 qdcount 从偏移 12 起界定问题段结束位置；无法界定返回 None。"""
1189	    pos = _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN
1190	    for _ in range(qdcount):
1191	        while True:
1192	            if pos >= len(reply):
1193	                return None
1194	            length = reply[pos]
1195	            kind = length & 0xC0
1196	            if kind == 0xC0:
1197	                if pos + 1 >= len(reply):
1198	                    return None
1199	                pos += 2
1200	                break
1201	            if kind != 0x00:
1202	                return None
1203	            pos += 1
1204	            if length == 0:
1205	                break
1206	            if pos + length > len(reply):
1207	                return None
1208	            pos += length
1209	        if pos + 4 > len(reply):
1210	            return None
1211	        pos += 4
1212	    return pos

1215	def _matching_reply(query, reply):
1216	    """reply 是否为 query 的合格上游应答；任何不符均为普通失败。"""
1217	    if not _MIN_MESSAGE_LEN <= len(reply) <= _MAX_REPLY_LEN:
1218	        return False
1219	    if not int.from_bytes(reply[2:4], "big") & _FLAG_QR:
1220	        return False
1221	    if reply[0:2] != query[0:2] or reply[4:6] != query[4:6]:
1222	        return False
1223	    qdcount = int.from_bytes(query[4:6], "big")
1224	    end = _reply_question_end(reply, qdcount)
1225	    if end is None:
1226	        return False
1227	    return reply[_MIN_MESSAGE_LEN:end] == query[_MIN_MESSAGE_LEN:]

1230	def forward(query, plan, now, timeout=5):
1231	    """按 plan 顺序模拟向上游转发 query。
1232	
1233	    每项上游仅取前 2 个事件；时钟自 now 累计：delay > timeout 记超时并
1234	    推进 timeout，否则推进 delay 后检查应答（None 或不合格记失败）。
1235	    成功返回 (reply, name, 结束时刻)；全部超时抛 UpstreamTimeout，
1236	    其余耗尽情形（含无事件）抛 UpstreamError。
1237	    """
1238	    msg = decode_query(query)  # TypeError/MessageError 原样传播
1239	    if msg["flags"] & _FLAG_QR:
1240	        raise EncodeError("query has QR set")
1241	    _check_non_negative_int(now, "now")
1242	    _check_int(timeout, "timeout")
1243	    if not _MIN_TIMEOUT <= timeout <= _MAX_TIMEOUT:
1244	        raise ValueError("timeout out of range")
1245	    items = _validate_plan(plan)
1246	    clock = now
1247	    saw_timeout = False
1248	    saw_other = False
1249	    for name, events in items:
1250	        for delay, reply in events[:_PLAN_EVENTS_USED]:
1251	            if delay > timeout:
1252	                saw_timeout = True
1253	                clock += timeout
1254	                continue
1255	            clock += delay
1256	            if reply is not None and _matching_reply(query, reply):
1257	                return reply, name, clock
1258	            saw_other = True
1259	    if saw_timeout and not saw_other:
1260	        raise UpstreamTimeout("all upstream attempts timed out")
1261	    raise UpstreamError("no usable upstream reply")
